_doc: Weapon model intake (T-087). weapons: every id in weapons.json -> the GLB that replaces its procedural WeaponModels build (source sketchfab > opengameart; null = keeps the greybox; 'ours' = wonder weapon). parts: our animation part name -> node name inside the GLB (Mag/Bolt/Slide/Pump/Cover/Barrels/...). native: the GLB as exported (glTF axes, +Y up): forward = the axis the muzzle points along, origin = the pack's own (bbox centre), length_m along forward, scale = real_length_m / length_m to bring it to metres, trigger_center when a Trigger part exists (grip reference). Our rig wants barrel along -Z, +Y up, origin at the right-hand grip: for forward '+X' rotate +90 deg about Y, for '-X' -90, for '-Z' nothing, for '+Z' 180, then scale, then translate the grip to the origin. assets: every converted folder with its parts, node list, per-node bounds (glTF axes, native scale) and tri counts. extras: casings and grenades. Regenerate with: python -I tools/intake_guns.py --no-convert
